title: Fresh-scene paired Cycles validation of the D5 motion-aware close camera
question: Does the frozen RS_S200_E225 camera pass the unchanged geometry template on all eight previously sealed frames when baked into a fresh scene, while producing finite, non-empty Cycles pixels distinct from the static-scale control?

validation.motionAcceptance: MOTION_AWARE passes the complete unchanged geometry template on all eight newly unsealed frames.
validation.staticControl: STATIC is measured and rendered on the same eight frames. Its pass/fail pattern is descriptive and cannot replace the motion acceptance gate.
validation.pixelAcceptance: Every one of 16 Combined passes is finite, non-empty and has positive RGB dynamic range; every same-frame STATIC/MOTION_AWARE decoded Combined digest differs.
validation.humanBoundary: All 16 native 960x540 PNGs require labeled human engineering review after the machine result. Machine PASS alone does not claim cinematic merit.

freshSceneProtocol.buildBlender: Open the master with factory startup and auto-exec disabled; create two new camera data/object/action triples; bake both transforms on all 96 integer frames; preserve source camera/action/markers; save one fresh derived blend.
freshSceneProtocol.renderBlender: Open only the fresh derived blend; route both scene.camera and the active close-shot timeline marker per condition; render the eight-by-two roster with the frozen Cycles settings; restore routing after each render.
freshSceneProtocol.independentBlender: Independently reopen the derived blend, verify both 96-frame bakes and scene invariants, measure geometry only on the eight unsealed frames, and independently decode all 16 EXR Combined passes.
freshSceneProtocol.nodeAuditor: Bind all parent/tool/runtime/process/resource identities, recompute roster, bake equations, geometry verdict, pixel pairing and outcome-neutral scientific mapping.

forbidden: reuse of a prior derived scene

sequence: Commit and push the complete D5 v0.4 evidence plus this D6 spec/protocol/journal while all five D6 tools and the D6 root are absent.
Implement and statically validate all tools without reading validation geometry or pixels.
Commit and push exact tool bytes.
Create fresh admission, build, render, independently audit and retain every failure.

output.immutableFailurePolicy: Any failure preserves the entire partial root and requires a separately preregistered correction plus fresh root.

decision.supportedWhen: All technical gates pass and MOTION_AWARE passes the unchanged geometry template on all eight newly unsealed frames.
decision.rejectedWhen: The full admitted run is valid but MOTION_AWARE fails at least one newly unsealed frame.
decision.invalidated: Any parent, tool, runtime, process, resource, fresh-scene, roster, bake, routing, independent-agreement, geometry-accounting or pixel-accounting failure yields scientificVerdict null.

nonClaims: D6 does not test the nine D5 derivation frames again and does not optimize a new camera.
D6 does not establish D3 grid uniqueness, cinematic storytelling, final-film photorealism or full-sequence Cycles stability.
Sixteen 16-spp diagnostic renders are not final delivery quality.
Even a supported machine verdict remains HUMAN_PENDING until all 16 native PNGs are reviewed.
